jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet North America Advisors SA provides investment services to private clients. Founded in 2007, the SEC-registered company devises portfolio diversification strategies for clients based in the US and Canada.

We are hiring a Senior Global Equity Portfolio Manager to strengthen the Portfolio Management team of its Geneva-based affiliate, Pictet North America Advisors, an SEC-registered independent financial advisor.

In this role, you will manage global equity mandates across different strategies, shaping differentiated portfolios for North American private clients and contributing to the ongoing development of our investment offering.

Your role

You will :

• Manage single-line equity mandates on behalf of private clients.

• Generate investment ideas and conduct fundamental bottom-up research.

• Select securities and construct portfolios.

• Provide clients with portfolio management updates and performance reports.

• Contribute actively to day-to-day portfolio management and trading activities

Your profile

• Master’s degree in Finance, or a qualification deemed equivalent.

• Postgraduate CIIA/CFA qualification, or equivalent.

• Adhere to the highest standards of integrity, show a strong team spirit and a genuine passion for securities analysis and investment management.

• Up to 10 years’ proven investment research experience, and keen to analyse diverse business models with a long-term perspective.

• Flexible and able to work effectively under pressure, meet tight deadlines and manage multiple tasks, including administrative duties.

• Flawless command of English, essential for preparing investment reports and communicating with clients and stakeholders.

• Ability to communicate complex financial concepts clearly and persuasively, as well as to build strong client relationships.

• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

As the successful applicant, you will be thorough and methodical in your approach to your work. In addition to excellent analytical skills and the ability to process information, you will have proven experience in the field of equity portfolio management. Your excellent communication skills will enable you to work closely with your colleagues.

You will be recognised for your results-driven, client-focused approach, as well as your integrity and discretion. You will show initiative and work accurately and independently, while respecting the confidential nature of the work entrusted to you.

Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include the Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Strategy & Projects, and Tax departments.

Reporting to the Learning & Talent Development Operations Manager, you will be working for the Pictet Academy, in the Human Resources department. The team supports the development of the Group’s employees and corporate culture at our offices around the world by assessing needs and implementing learning solutions to meet them.

Your role

You will provide operational and administrative support for training programmes and initiatives within the Pictet Academy and the Group’s Learning & Talent Development (LTD) community. Acting as a key point of contact for learning-related activities, you will ensure the smooth delivery of learning programmes, stakeholder support, LMS administration, reporting and cost management.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the delivery of learning solutions across the Group while working closely with a diverse network of internal stakeholders and external partners.

Operations, administration and reporting
• Administrating the SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management System (LMS), including course and class creation, enrolment management, learner support and system administration.
• Acting as LMS co-administrator, providing first-line support to users, troubleshooting issues and ensuring a positive learning experience.
• Acting as a key point of contact for learning-related enquiries and administrative requests, ensuring a high level of service to internal stakeholders.
• Supporting LTD managers with course planning, scheduling and coordination.
• Executing training programme communication plans and following up on assessments and evaluations.
• Managing training logistics, including room bookings, catering arrangements and maintenance of shared files on SharePoint.
• Producing and maintaining training reports, dashboards and operational metrics.
• Providing technical support to users of learning and collaboration platforms, including Klaxoon, Easygenerator and DataCamp.

Invoicing and cost management
• Managing the end-to-end processing of invoices, including collection, review, coding and submission to the Accounting Department.
• Monitoring invoice status and payments through ESKER and following up on outstanding invoices with suppliers.
• Producing cost estimates and liaising with external training providers and vendors.
• Collaborating in the invoice review process for all Pictet Academy-related expenditures and verifying SAP reporting.
• Contributing to quarterly budget reviews and cost-tracking activities.

Your profile

• At least three years’ experience in an operational support, HR administration, learning administration or similar role.
• Hands-on experience administering a Learning Management System (LMS) is required.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data validation and reporting).
• Previous experience in Learning & Talent Development, Training Administration or HR Operations would be a strong asset.
• Proven experience in delivering a high standard of customer-focused service and stakeholder support.
• Strong organisational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
• Ability to work independently, prioritise competing demands and deliver accurate results in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience in invoice management, budget tracking and cost estimation.
• Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Team-oriented, proactive and service-minded.
• Experience with reporting and data analysis tools.
• Experience with enterprise systems and digital learning platforms. Knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors Learning, JIRA, ESKER and SharePoint would be a strong advantage.
• Written and spoken fluency in French and English.
• Resident in Switzerland.

The successful candidate will be agile, versatile, and highly organised to meet deadlines, as well as having good problem-solving skills. You are keen to put your experience to good use in a team that will appreciate your range of skills and proactive approach.
